# Backup dependency notices

The WebDAV backup implementation uses these modules. Full versions and checksums are pinned in go.mod and go.sum.

- filippo.io/age v1.3.2 — https://github.com/FiloSottile/age
- filippo.io/hpke v0.4.0 — https://github.com/FiloSottile/hpke
- github.com/klauspost/compress v1.20.3 — https://github.com/klauspost/compress
- golang.org/x/crypto v0.55.0 — https://go.googlesource.com/crypto

Upstream license texts accompany this notice. This directory describes the new backup dependencies, not the complete dependency inventory of nasctl.
